text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Leader of the Kurdistan Democratic Party Massoud Barzani rejects Iranian mediation in the conflict with his rival Jalal Talabani, leader of Patriotic Union of Kurdistan.
- Iraq's National Assembley (parliament) authorises the Oil Ministry to conclude a deal with Romania to dig 48 oil wells in Iraq.
(The above stories were also carried by IRAQ and QADISSIYA.)
- Iraq and France sign an agreement for social welfare.
